title: repotools
description: Types of the repository checks; mise run //repo:codegen writes src/repotools/models.py from this file.

Command.description: The repotools subcommands, one per mise task.

ZeroBash.description: Report tracked shell scripts, shell shebangs and multi-line mise run.

MainGuard.description: Refuse a move of refs/heads/main, read from the reference-transaction rows on stdin, unless it is to origin/main.

MainGuardInstall.description: Register the main guard as this repository's reference-transaction hook, after a self-test.

bin.description: The installed repotools executable the hook runs, outside every checkout

MainGuardRemove.description: Remove the main guard's hook entry from this repository's config and record that the owner switched it off.

MainGuardArmed.description: Print install when hk's post-merge step must install the guard: on main, not switched off, no copy of HEAD's.

Finding.description: One zero-bash leftover, printed as a JSON line.

path.description: Tracked file, relative to the repository root

detail.description: The file suffix, the shebang, or the TOML key of the run

CommitText.description: A commit's message, which the reviewer reads and the approval covers with HEAD and the index.

PrText.description: A pull request's title and body, which the reviewer reads and the approval covers with HEAD.

PanePin.description: Name the Codex session whose approval this checkout accepts.

session.description: The session id, as in the rollout file's name

ReviewPython.description: Have a read-only Codex reviewer check changes against CODING_STANDARDS.md.

path.description: Directory whose uncommitted changes are reviewed

commit.description: Review this commit instead of the uncommitted changes

out.description: Report file (default review-python.md in the git dir)

ReviewApproved.description: Refuse unless review:python passed on exactly the staged python/ files.

PrivacyScan.description: Refuse this machine's private paths in tracked files, given files, or outgoing commits.

patterns.description: Private paths, one per line; lines under 8 characters are dropped, and none left exits 2

files.description: Files to scan, as mise's shell-quoted usage_file; empty scans every tracked file

outgoing.description: Scan every commit not yet on a remote, branches and tags

Options.description: What a repotools command parses from its arguments.

Fingerprint.description: What an approval must name, printed as a JSON line.

fingerprint.description: Hash of what is approved: HEAD with the index and message, or with a pull request's text

RolloutLine.description: One line of a Codex session rollout; only the fields the check reads.

cwd.description: The folder the session started in

type.description: read-only when nothing may be written

access.description: read when the entry only reads

type.description: restricted when entries list everything allowed

PermissionProfile.description: A turn's effective permissions; only a managed profile lists its filesystem access.

turn_id.description: The turn these settings apply to

approval_policy.description: never when no command can ask for more

OutputText.description: One content part of a message; an image part has no text.

type.description: output_text for what the assistant wrote

TaskEvent.description: A rollout's task_started, task_complete or turn_aborted payload.

TeReviewCommand.description: The te-review subcommands, the word after te-review.

TeReviewCollect.description: Freeze the TokenEconomizer Claude ledger rows of a window into a new, create-only evidence collection.

since.description: First calendar day of the window, inclusive

until.description: Last calendar day of the window, inclusive

tz.description: IANA time zone the calendar days are read in, such as America/Chicago

out.description: The collection directory, which must not exist

receipts.description: A receipt manifest (ReceiptManifest); its files are checked, copied and hashed into the collection

cadence_receipt.description: A CadenceReceipt proving the proposer cadence; without one every session's cadence is unknown

synthetic_manifest.description: A receipt manifest of synthetic receipts only, naming the synthetic sessions

ErrorCode.description: Why te-review collect stopped; it writes nothing when it does.

CodedFailure.description: Why a te-review command stopped, printed as a JSON line on stderr.

SessionRow.description: A TokenEconomizer 0.1.0 ledger session row, as plugin/fold.py fold_locked writes it; other keys are unknown.

host.description: The agent host; this adapter reads Claude only

folded_at.description: When the session was folded, Unix seconds

ended.description: Session end, Unix seconds; the window selects on it

imported.description: Folded from the agent's history, from before the plugin

error.description: Why the transcript could not be read

untool_applied.description: Deny rules the session ran under

overhead.description: Mechanism overhead tokens, by ledger.py OVERHEAD_KEYS

OverheadRow.description: A TokenEconomizer 0.1.0 ledger overhead row, as plugin/judge.py run_job writes it; other keys are an unknown schema.

host.description: The agent host; this adapter reads Claude only

job.description: The judge job; a charge without one is ambiguous

at.description: When it was charged, Unix seconds

overhead.description: Mechanism overhead tokens, by ledger.py OVERHEAD_KEYS

RowClass.description: What the collection made of a distinct ledger row.

source.description: The ledger file, relative to the state root

LedgerRead.description: One ledger row as read: its store, its place, the validated record and the row itself.

store.description: The repository store, repos/<label> under the state root

EvidenceRow.description: One distinct ledger row and its class; identical repeats are one row with their count.

ref.description: Opaque reference, stable within the collection

store.description: The repository store, repos/<label> under the state root

job.description: The charge's judge job; null for a session or a charge without one

count.description: How many identical copies were read

Evidence.description: evidence.json: every distinct row read, in source order, the receipts and the judgment candidates.

cadence_receipt.description: The cadence receipt, when one was given

sessions.description: Each session row's cohort and cadence

facts.description: Every learned fact, as it is now

import_folds.description: Paid live folds near an import's end

import_note.description: What the import evidence covers, in words

Window.description: Inclusive calendar days in a time zone, read as the half-open instants [start, end).

end.description: The day after until at 00:00 in tz, excluded

Label.description: INTERIM when collected before the window's end, else FINAL.

SourceFile.description: One consumed ledger file, as hashed before and after the read.

Mirror.description: A TokenEconomizer source file whose row shapes the adapter mirrors.

sha256.description: Hash of the file at the mirrored version

adapter.description: The ledger adapter, named by the TokenEconomizer version it mirrors

schema.description: The evidence and collection schema version

Collection.description: collection.json: when and from what evidence.json was built.

collection_id.description: sha256 over the window, versions, every source's bytes and evidence.json; not worksheet.json

collected_at.description: When, in the window's time zone

sources.description: The consumed files: ledgers, TokenEconomizer state, manifests and receipts

ReceiptKind.description: What a receipt shows; a closed list.

RedirectLink.description: A redirect event, by the session it was logged in and its time.

at.description: The event's at, Unix seconds, exactly as events.jsonl has it

Receipt.description: One owner-supplied receipt file and what it is evidence for, by native ids.

path.description: The file, absolute or relative to the manifest's folder

sha256.description: The file's hash; any other content is refused

imports.description: Stores, repos/<label>, whose import operation it shows

ReceiptManifest.description: The receipts given to collect, by --receipts or --synthetic-manifest.

CadenceProof.description: How a cadence receipt proves the fold process's effective policy (TokenEconomizer plugin/config.py load_config).

CapturedConfig.description: A fold process's effective configuration, as captured; only the cadence is read.

CadenceReceipt.description: --cadence-receipt: the global cadence change and the proof of the policy a fold process ran under.

sessions.description: The sessions the proof covers, by session id; each must name exactly one collected session

changed_at.description: When te config set --global changed the cadence

before.description: The proven cadence before the change, if any

process_started.description: When the fold process the proof is about started; only its folds, at or after this time, are proven

repo_override.description: A repository config.json set the cadence

env_override.description: An environment variable set the cadence

captured_config.description: For captured_config: the process's effective configuration

EventLine.description: A TokenEconomizer 0.1.0 events.jsonl line, as plugin/controller.py _log writes it; its kind decides the rest.

shadow.description: Logged in shadow mode, where nothing reaches the agent

RedirectKind.description: The redirect events: a nudge, and the still-stuck notice after one.

RedirectEvent.description: A nudge or abort events.jsonl line, as plugin/controller.py post_tool logs it.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls in the turn so far

HistoryState.description: A TokenEconomizer 0.1.0 history.json, the store's one import operation (plugin/history.py).

reason.description: Why it was skipped or stopped

attempt.description: The session a dead run was on

started.description: When the plan was made, Unix seconds

heartbeat.description: The last sign of life, Unix seconds

finished.description: When the plan was done, Unix seconds

FactLife.description: A learned fact's lifecycle; only its state is read.

MechanismFact.description: One fact of a mechanism state file (microskills distiller.py or envfacts.py to_dict).

MechanismState.description: A mechanisms/<manual|envfacts>_state/<repo>.json file; only its facts are read.

InjectionState.description: injection.json; only the ids of the facts rendered for injection are read.

EvidenceReceipt.description: A receipt as frozen into the collection, with the evidence refs it links.

path.description: The copy, relative to sources/ in the collection

origin.description: The file it was copied from

links.description: The rows and candidates it links, by ref

SessionCohort.description: A session's class, from receipts only.

CadenceLabel.description: The proposer cadence a session was folded under, or unknown.

CadenceReason.description: Why a session's cadence is what it is.

SessionEvidence.description: A session row's cohort and cadence.

RedirectState.description: What is known of a redirect's delivery: only delivery_confirmed, with a host_delivery receipt, counts as delivered.

FactMechanism.description: Which mechanism learned a fact: manual is the paid proposer (distiller), envfacts the free one.

FactProvenance.description: Whether a fact_snapshot receipt places the fact in time; without one, when it was produced is unknown.

FactCandidate.description: A learned fact as it is now (a snapshot), to judge.

source.description: The state file, relative to the state root

receipts.description: Its fact_injection, fact_use and fact_snapshot receipts

ImportCompletion.description: How far an import operation got.

FoldProvenance.description: What ties a live fold to an import: a history_fold receipt, or only its time.

ImportFoldCandidate.description: A paid live fold that the import may have run after it finished (plugin/history.py _run_locked).

folded_at.description: When it was folded, Unix seconds

ImportCoverage.description: Whether history_fold receipts cover past import operations, or only the current state was seen.

RedirectVerdict.description: The owner's judgment of a redirect.

OwnerAssessment.description: The owner's assessment of a paid fact.

FactReason.description: Why the owner assessed a paid fact so.

FactVerdict.description: Whether a learned fact is wrong.

ImportVerdict.description: What ties an import candidate to its effect: proven needs a receipt; time alone is only a candidate.

NotRunOutcome.description: What became of a NOT_RUN item.

DeferReason.description: Why a NOT_RUN item was deferred again.

WorksheetRedirect.description: Section 1: a redirect in the window.

origin_ref.description: The evidence ref of its paid origin

WorksheetImport.description: Section 4: an import completed in the window, or a paid live fold near it.

receipt_ref.description: The receipt a proven verdict rests on

WorksheetNotRun.description: Section 5: a NOT_RUN item carried over, by its not_run receipt.

Worksheet.description: worksheet.json: the template the owner fills; outside the collection id, which it carries.

Failure.description: Why a command stopped, printed as a JSON line on stderr.
